name: Orca ADE
description: Installs Orca ADE through mise on Wolfi base images and optionally starts a persistent headless Orca server for DevPod workspaces.

version.description: Orca GitHub release to install: latest or an explicit release version.

autoStart.description: Whether to start a headless Orca server from the feature postStartCommand.

baseDir.description: Orca profile directory. Mount this from the host to persist server state.

port.description: Port for the Orca server to listen on.

pairingAddress.description: Address advertised to paired clients. This does not change the server's bind address.
